title: Augmentation-compatible ringed Koszul colimit
statement: ∃ alpha : colimit (ringedKoszulDiagram O r b) ≅ (ringedExtendedCech O r b).1, alpha.hom ≫ (ringedExtendedCech O r b).2 = colimit.desc _ (ringedKoszulAugmentationCocone O r b)

proof.text: Use the proved one-section positive Koszul localization colimit to obtain augmentation-compatible colimit cocones for each factor.

The tensor-Hom adjunction for cochain complexes proves preservation of sequential colimits by tensoring on the left; braiding gives preservation on the right. Mathlib isColimitOfPreserves₂ therefore tensors two colimit cocones. The diagonal functor on the filtered category of natural numbers is final, so restricting this tensor cocone to the diagonal remains a colimit. Induct over the ordered factors, with the identity cocone on O[0] for the empty tensor. Naturality of the tensor bifunctor and the augmentation equations for the two factors prove the augmentation equation at the successor step.

Compare the resulting cocone with the chosen colimit by uniqueness of colimits. Check the required augmentation equation after composing with every colimit inclusion; the cocone factorization equations and the stagewise augmentation equality give the result.
